stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The museum opens a new section for local history.
items.sentenceZh: 博物馆开设了一个展示本地历史的新区域。
items.scene: A museum interior is visibly divided into several distinct galleries, with one newly opened side area containing local artifacts and visitors entering it from the main hall. The architectural boundary makes the new section unmistakable without any signs or text.
items.altText: 博物馆主厅旁新开放的展区陈列着本地历史物品。

items.sentenceEn: The town adopted an environmental plan to protect the river.
items.sentenceZh: 这座城镇通过了一项保护河流的环保计划。
items.scene: Residents plant native trees and remove litter along a recovering river while fish and birds return to clear water beside the town. The coordinated care for the natural environment is the clear focal story, with no signs, charts or readable text.
items.altText: 居民在城镇河边植树清理垃圾，鱼鸟重返水域。

items.sentenceEn: Sunlight passes through the colored glass.
items.sentenceZh: 阳光穿过彩色玻璃。
items.scene: Warm morning sunlight streams through a large colored glass window and casts vivid translucent patches of red, blue and gold across a stone floor. The transparent material and transmitted light are visually central, without letters, symbols or text in the window.
items.altText: 阳光穿过彩色玻璃，在石地面投下斑斓光影。

items.meaningZh: 技术；技巧；技能；熟练；熟练工人
items.sentenceEn: Years of practice turned weaving into her finest skill.
items.sentenceZh: 多年的练习使编织成为她最出色的技能。
items.scene: An experienced adult weaver confidently guides many colored threads through a hand loom, producing a precise complex pattern while an older simple practice swatch rests nearby. Her controlled hands and polished result communicate learned skill.
items.altText: 熟练的织工在手工织机上编出精细复杂的纹样。

items.sentenceEn: My sister helps me repair the bicycle.
items.sentenceZh: 我的姐妹帮我修理自行车。
items.scene: Two adult sisters with a clear family resemblance work together beside a bicycle, one holding the wheel steady while the other tightens the chain. Their cooperative expressions and shared task feel natural and affectionate.
items.altText: 两位姐妹一起扶着车轮并修理自行车链条。

items.sentenceEn: The outdoor film begins at 7 PM.
items.sentenceZh: 露天电影在晚上七点开始。
items.scene: At dusk, an outdoor cinema audience settles into chairs as the projection screen begins to glow, while a nearby analog clock with no numerals shows its minute hand at twelve and hour hand at seven. The evening sky and starting event make the time of day clear.
items.altText: 黄昏时露天电影开场，无数字时钟的指针指向七点。

items.sentenceEn: The professor demonstrates a volcano model to the class.
items.sentenceZh: 教授向全班演示火山模型。
items.scene: A university professor stands at a demonstration table activating a safe miniature volcano while adult students observe closely from curved lecture seating. Academic teaching, expertise and student attention clearly establish the professor role without any board text.
items.altText: 大学教授在讲台上向学生演示火山模型。

items.sentenceEn: The rescue operation brings the stranded hikers home.
items.sentenceZh: 救援行动把受困的徒步者安全带回家。
items.scene: A coordinated mountain rescue operation unfolds as a rope team guides two stranded hikers from a rocky ledge toward a waiting rescue vehicle below. Multiple trained rescuers perform complementary roles in one organized effort.
items.altText: 山地救援队协作把受困徒步者带离岩石高处。

items.sentenceEn: Careful financial planning helped the bakery buy a new oven.
items.sentenceZh: 谨慎的财务规划帮助面包店买下了一台新烤箱。
items.scene: A bakery owner calmly divides coins into several unlabeled jars beside a simple blank pie-shaped planning board, while a newly purchased commercial oven is being installed in the background. The saved money visibly leads to the useful investment.
items.altText: 面包店主规划资金，店内正在安装新烤箱。

items.sentenceEn: The broken lock provided evidence of a crime.
items.sentenceZh: 损坏的锁提供了犯罪发生的证据。
items.scene: In a closed shop doorway at dawn, an investigator wearing gloves examines a freshly broken lock and scattered metal fragments while the interior remains undisturbed. The damaged entry point clearly suggests an unlawful act without showing violence, labels or police tape text.
items.altText: 调查人员在店门口检查被破坏的锁和金属碎片。

items.sentenceEn: The dancers step onto the stage for rehearsal.
items.sentenceZh: 舞者们登上舞台进行排练。
items.scene: Several adult dancers step from the dark wings onto a brightly lit wooden theater stage, where one choreographer waits near the front and empty seats recede beyond the footlights. The boundary between backstage and performance space is unmistakable.
items.altText: 舞者们从侧幕后走上灯光照亮的木质舞台。

items.sentenceEn: After checking the bridge, the engineer says it is ok.
items.sentenceZh: 检查桥梁后，工程师表示它没有问题。
items.scene: A bridge engineer finishes a careful inspection of bolts and supports, then gives a confident thumbs-up to waiting cyclists as the safe bridge opens. Her relieved expression and approving gesture clearly communicate that everything is acceptable.
items.altText: 工程师检查完桥梁后向等候的人竖起拇指。

items.sentenceEn: The shopper will compare the two backpacks before choosing one.
items.sentenceZh: 购物者会先比较两个背包，再选择其中一个。
items.scene: A shopper holds exactly two different backpacks side by side, weighing their size, straps and pockets with an attentive expression before making a choice. Both bags are equally visible and no other backpacks appear nearby.
items.altText: 购物者把两个不同的背包并排拿着进行比较。

items.meaningZh: 权力；当权者；当局；权威；专家
items.sentenceEn: The ranger has the authority to close the dangerous trail.
items.sentenceZh: 护林员有权关闭危险的步道。
items.scene: A uniformed park ranger decisively closes a simple rope barrier across a storm-damaged mountain trail while hikers stop and follow the safe alternate path she indicates. Her official role and others' compliance visibly communicate legitimate authority without signs or text.
items.altText: 护林员封闭受损山路，徒步者服从指引改道。

items.sentenceEn: He runs toward the bus but will miss it by a few seconds.
items.sentenceZh: 他跑向公交车，却会晚几秒错过它。
items.scene: An adult commuter runs toward a city bus just as its doors close and it begins pulling away from the curb. The small but increasing gap, his outstretched hand and urgent expression make the near miss immediately clear.
items.altText: 公交车正驶离站台，一名乘客伸手追赶却没赶上。

items.sentenceEn: The architect builds a model to test her design.
items.sentenceZh: 建筑师制作模型来检验她的设计。
items.scene: An architect adjusts a detailed scale model of a curved community building while comparing it with clean geometric sketches that contain no writing or measurements. Movable model pieces and thoughtful experimentation show a design being tested.
items.altText: 建筑师对照无文字草图调整弧形建筑模型。

items.meaningZh: 种类；方式；品质；态度；举止
items.sentenceEn: We sort the buttons by color and size.
items.sentenceZh: 我们按照颜色和大小给纽扣分类。
items.scene: Seen from above, two adult pairs of hands arrange a mixed pile of buttons into clearly separated groups by matching color and size. The ordered groups emerge from the unsorted central pile, with no labels, numbers or text.
items.altText: 人们把混合纽扣按照颜色和大小分成整齐几组。

items.sentenceEn: One brave act saves the bird from the tangled net.
items.sentenceZh: 一个勇敢的行动把小鸟从缠绕的网中救了出来。
items.scene: An adult carefully reaches across a shallow marsh to cut a trapped bird free from a tangled abandoned net while another person steadies them from the bank. The decisive helpful act and the bird's release form one clear cause-and-effect story.
items.altText: 一名成人勇敢靠近湿地，用工具剪开缠住小鸟的网。

items.sentenceEn: Exactly ten lanterns glow around the quiet courtyard.
items.sentenceZh: 安静的庭院四周正好亮着十盏灯笼。
items.scene: A quiet square courtyard at blue hour contains exactly ten clearly separated glowing lanterns arranged in a single visible ring around the central tree: five on the near side and five on the far side. No other lanterns, lamps, glowing windows or light sources appear.
items.altText: 蓝色暮光中，安静庭院里正好有十盏灯笼围着树发光。

items.sentenceEn: Her knowledge of plants helps her identify the safe berries.
items.sentenceZh: 她的植物知识帮助她辨认出安全的浆果。
items.scene: An experienced botanist compares two visibly different berry plants in a forest clearing, confidently placing the safe variety into a basket while leaving the warning-colored variety untouched. A text-free illustrated field guide and careful observation communicate applied plant knowledge.
items.altText: 植物学家观察两种浆果，只把安全的一种放入篮中。
